Arianna Huffington

By: Joy Summers | Production

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
We sit down with Arianna Huffington - one of the worlds most influential woman

Unique Selling Point:
founder of Huffington post, sleep evangelist

Summary:
Arianna Huffington has written fifteen books and she has been on Times list of one of the most influential people in the world. This week she was in South Africa to share her message on how to thrive in a digital world and her big idea is to get enough sleep
It sounds simple but Ms Huffington brings us the latest research around sleep

Further information:
Arianna Huffington proposal



She says it’s a myth that we have to burn out to succeed, that there is no such thing as multitasking, we are actually task switching. She tells people to put away their devices and I gives them a leather bound notebook. Ironically she says the digital revolution addiction has exacerbated burnout and she advices that we escort our devices out of our bedrooms at the end of the day. She should know because two years after founding Huffington Post she collapsed from burnout. Now other top CEO’s are taking a leaf out of her book, Jeff Bezos says his eight hours sleep benefits Amazon shareholders and improves his decision making and what she asks are CEO’s paid for? Their decision making not their stamina.


The obnoxious room- mate living in our heads
She says that woman especially have a voice of doubt in their heads and we need to learn to silence that voice which stops us experiencing the wonder and magic of life. And she is big on giving. When we give back we are pursuing a short cut to happiness

SO WHAT IS NEEDED FOR A BETTER WORLD

Increasingly as technology takes over – machines cannot take over empathy and creativity and that is where companies that prioritise these are going to have a huge competitive advantage and companies are beginning to realise that

BUT WHAT HAPPENS IF YOU CANT COMPLETE EVERYTHING IN A DAY
If you can complete everything you should in a day you don’t have an interesting enough job
You need to declare the day at an end

She loves to quote from her greek heritage and we need sacred spaces as an example Archimedes said: Give me a place to stand and I can move the world
And she compares the breath to Ariadne’s thread


Carte Blanche speaks to Arianna Huffington about Thriving in a digital noise, getting enough sleep, rejection, criticism and the new leader of the free world Donald Trump

Press Release:


Arianna Huffington
She is the co-founder of the Huffington Post, and until a couple of weeks ago, was its editor-in-chief. Arianna Huffington has written 15 books and in 2011 Time Magazine listed her as one of the most influential people in the world. But this success came at a high personal cost. After suffering burnout, she directed her energies to educating the world about the power of a good night’s sleep. About to launch a new business venture called Thrive Global, this week she was a keynote speaker at the Discovery Leadership Summit, and sat down for a candid interview with Carte Blanche.


Script:


Arianna Huffington Final script

Commentary One
770 Broadway, New York New York. Home of the Huffington post, one of the most visited news sites in the world. But its co- founder Arianna Huffington began this global news organization in a small home office 11 years ago

Up sound
Its Arianna Huffington everybody

Commentary two
Now considered one of the most influential media people in the world, Arianna Huffington grew up in a one- bedroom flat in Athens, where her mother taught her important lessons about failure

Arianna
I was very lucky to have a mother who had convinced me from an early age that failure is not the opposite of success/ she used to say that failure is a stepping stone to success, so I had come to believe that if you are going to take risks – you might fail, there are no guarantees

Commentary three
She is the author of 15 books, and applied her mother’s wisdom when she first started out.

Arianna
so when my second book was rejected by 36 publishers by which time I had run out of money, I felt that I wanted to persevere but I had to find a way to keep myself going so I went to a bank and asked for a loan and by some miracle, the bank manager gave it to me and that helped me keep things together for another three rejections and then I got an acceptance.

Commentary Four
This week she was a keynote speaker at the Discovery Leadership summit in Sandton

Up sound Arianna
Wherever you look you see people running on empty, walking through life like zombies see around corners leadership…and basically missing out on the meaning and purpose of life

Commentary five
Onward, upward and inward is her message in her 2014 book: Thrive, in which she
re-examines our definitions of success

Arianna
We are always breathless, and hurrying and we are missing the joy of life. For me joy is incredibly important! We have shrunken our lives to our to do lists.



LINK
Last year Arianna Huffington said she will only cover the trump presidential campaign of the Huffington post in the entertainment section of the Huffington Post

Arianna
I am very proud of the fact that we opposed him from day one and refused to legitimize him

Up sound Trump
You know I have never been a fan of Arianna Huffington. I think she is a terrible person, I have never liked her, …she knows that

Arianna
He was bragging he was only getting 4 hours sleep and he would wake up in the middle of the night and retweet Mussolini etc /now he will be the president in January and its now responsibility of the Huffington Post and the media to cover what he does. Not to cover what he said in the campaign

Commentary six
She suggests Trump’s election is a wake-up call

Arianna
We can no longer ignore that people are left behind by globalization and they feel hopeless and fearful and these are precisely the conditions that breed demagogues

Commentary seven
Huffington is a self- described sleep evangelist and her new book the Sleep revolution sets out the latest science for why most of us should get between 7-9 hours sleep a night, a habit she has developed after collapsing from exhaustion two years after starting the Huffington Post

DEVI
And you also learnt to declare when the day is over
Arianna Laughs
Yes exactly! I am glad that you remember that because you have to declare the day is over because the day is never really over – no person – most people in any interesting job have incompletions at the end of the day. If you have no incompletions, your job is not interesting enough so you need to declare an end and you need to say this is a time for me to recharge and start again the next morning.

Up sound Discovery leadership
Everything is based on microsteps for change, because that is how human beings change

Commentary eight
Her own experience has taught her to overcome self- doubt

Devi
You talk about mostly woman having that obnoxious voice in our heads?
Arianna
The obnoxious room-mate in our heads. Yes, men have it too but men are much better at shutting it off. We listen to that voice as if it’s true but it’s not, that is the voice of self doubt, its an exhausting voice to live with and I have had it a lot of my life because I started my life as an extremely self-judgemental person. So when I look back its not what I did, but what my mind did afterwards. Do you have that voice ever?

Devi
All the time
Arianna
It’s stupid!

Commentary nine
At 66 years old, she thought the Huffington Post would be her last act. But last month Arianna resigned. Thrive Global, her new business venture will give expression to her passion to assist individuals and companies reduce stress and burnout

Arianna
You know human beings include amazing potential and each one of us has that sacred of wisdom, peace, we need to connect with it, because otherwise we are missing the point of life

THE END 6 01.

PROMO ONE 10 seconder
Commentary
Arianna Huffington is redefining our definition of success
Arianna
For me joy is incredibly important. We have shrunken our lives to our to do lists

PROMO TWO
Donald Trump
You know I have never been a fan of Arianna Huffington
Commentary
Arianna Huffington is unequivocal about the Huffington posts stance on Donald Trump
Arianna
I am very proud of the fact that we opposed him from day one and refused to legitimize him

PROMO THREE
Arianna Huffington was in South Africa this week for the Discovery leadership Summit
Arianna
Wherever you look you see people who are running on empty. Walking through life like zombies
